author: T Bryant
body: All around impressed with the service! The team was not just friendly but genuinely caring. I needed dental implants and they suggested the all-on-x as a viable option. Their professionalism made everything run smoothly, and they were always there to answer any questions. This place is definitely a top choice for anyone needing dental work, especially for those looking for convenience in their appointments!

author: Windy Zant
body: Walking into this clinic always feels like a breath of fresh air. The warm and inviting greeting sets the tone right away, making everything feel so effortless. Virma is always there, ready to assist with a smile and great care. And Melissa, what can I say? She truly makes patients feel supported and safe, guiding through every step of the treatment. Had my follow up visit 2 months post upper dental implant and felt in good hands. Thank you all!

author: Wanda Hawkins
body: Highly recommend Dr. Nahlah, premier provider for thin arch dental implants. He helped me with all-on-X and it's life-changing. The care was super compassionate, and all the little details were covered. Was never rushed and he made sure I was comfortable throughout. Couldn’t ask for anything more in cosmetic dentistry. Fantastic service every time!

author: Kelvin Shavers
body: The staff really knows what they are doing with dental implants. Treatment was smooth and focused. The all-on-x approach was new but they made me feel at ease. Everything was thorough and the atmosphere was positive. Best decision to choose this place for my needs.

author: Lanka Pearson
body: I’ve never felt so comfortable in a dental office.  Dr Nahlah and his team are very welcoming and friendly.  The office is beautiful and clean.  Thank you for taking care of me!

author: Stephen Hill
body: Wonderful customer service and professionalism in all my interactions.  Stephanie was Outstanding....very pleasant, patient, and professional. Dr. Nahlah was very informative andhelpful, and I appreciate his professionalism as well.  I'll keep you in mind if any of my contacts are looking for dental work in NOVA.

author: Guadalupe Juras
body: Got an all-on-x consultation at a dental office last week. The staff were really gentle and took their time explaining everything. Felt very comfortable during the procedure. Plus, the results are just unbelievable. This approach is a game changer for anyone looking for full-mouth implants. Will definitely come back.

author: Michael DeGuzman
body: AWESOME! Dr. Nahlah provides such a friendly environment. Got my dental bridges done and can't stop smiling. The staff is super courteous and made sure I was comfortable. A visit feels like catching up with old friends. If you need a dental implant or dental crowns, this is the place to go, you won't regret it!
